title: Texas S.B. 502, 80th Legislature (2007), enrolled bill text - minimum coverage amounts
claims: The enrolled text of S.B. 502 amends Transportation Code section 601.072, titled Minimum Coverage Amounts.

The enrolled text sets minimum amounts of $25,000 for bodily injury to or death of one person in one accident, $50,000 for bodily injury to or death of two or more persons in one accident, and $25,000 for damage to or destruction of property of others in one accident, effective April 1, 2008.

The enrolled text provides that effective January 1, 2011 the minimum amounts of motor vehicle liability insurance coverage required to establish financial responsibility are $30,000 for bodily injury to or death of one person in one accident, $60,000 for bodily injury to or death of two or more persons in one accident, and $25,000 for damage to or destruction of property of others in one accident.
The act itself takes effect September 1, 2007.
